modelCoverage.scoringBudgetLimitation: Two score calls cannot score all four nonempty candidates under a complete critic block. Such requests explicitly skip critic scoring; this section establishes actual neural execution coverage, not all-model semantic review or cross-critic coverage.

semanticReview.workflow: Reviewer read the saved original questions, criteria and responses only. No model execution, training, file mutation or programmatic semantic decision rule was used by the reviewer. The structured judgments below transcribe that qualitative review.

cases.criterion: Debe indicar jueves; se proporciona el dato en la historia.

single_primary.reason: No indica jueves ni responde qué día abre.

default_ensemble.reason: No indica jueves; repite el nombre y termina incompleta.

cases.criterion: Debe usar sábado y conservar la corrección.

single_primary.reason: No indica sábado ni recoge la corrección.

default_ensemble.reason: No indica sábado; la repetición no expresa un día de apertura.

cases.criterion: Debe resolver el antecedente como la apertura del taller: domingo.

single_primary.reason: No resuelve la referencia a la apertura ni indica domingo; resulta incomprensible.

default_ensemble.reason: Introduce una afirmación ajena a la historia y no indica domingo.

cases.criterion: Debe conservar visita y prohibición de publicar datos personales.

single_primary.reason: No conserva organizar una visita ni la prohibición de publicar datos personales.

default_ensemble.reason: Responde con una lista ajena a la petición y omite objetivo y restricción.

cases.criterion: Debe reconocer que no tiene ese nombre, sin inventarlo.

single_primary.reason: No reconoce que desconoce el nombre; produce una explicación incoherente. No inventar un nombre por sí solo no cumple el criterio.

default_ensemble.reason: Reconoce directamente que falta el dato y no inventa un nombre.

cases.criterion: Debe contestar al saludo con español comprensible.

single_primary.reason: Contesta al saludo con español comprensible, como exige el criterio.

default_ensemble.reason: Contesta al saludo con español comprensible, como exige el criterio.

cases.criterion: Debe indicar confirmar el horario, sin inventar acciones ejecutadas.

single_primary.reason: Sustituye confirmar el horario por una acción ajena a la visita.

default_ensemble.reason: Sustituye confirmar el horario por una acción ajena a la visita.

semanticReview.interpretation: The only category improvement was missing-information. Seven cases retained their category; five ensemble responses still failed. This eight-case short-response diagnostic does not validate general conversation, corrections or antecedent tracking. Truncated outputs are assessed as actually emitted; no successful continuation is assumed.
semanticReview.revalidation: Final component rerun preserved every reviewed quality response model ID, exact text and generated token IDs. Prior read-only qualitative judgments remain applicable.

limitations: Execution and likelihood ranking do not prove understanding, truth, specialized expertise or improved conversational quality.
Reply caps of 24 tokens for quality and two for coverage bound runtime and limit conclusions.
The time budget is cooperative between operations; a running neural call can exceed it.
Thirty-five distinct weight identities are historical own models and are not independent training replications.
Source support is lexical; the auxiliary RNN is a diagnostic and tie-break, not a semantic critic.
The coverage pass uses a cheaper scoring budget than the default quality configuration.

executionCostSummary.kind: arithmetic totals of recorded actual calls; not semantic grades
executionCostSummary.costInterpretation: Local CPU work only. Whole-run elapsed time and process peak RSS are recorded separately. Quality compares two coexisting runtimes; its single-primary baseline can add one resident Transformer beyond the ensemble cache limit. Coverage repeats its two anchors and one wrapped rotating member; 68 calls do not mean 68 distinct models.
